name: @arukellt/board
description: Kanban workspace for Arukellt issues, ADRs and docs: tabbed, split-pane SPA with agent handoff helpers

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr server/main.ts --outDir dist/server
scripts.build:pages: tsc -b && npm run build:server && BOARD_STATIC=1 vite build && node scripts/build-data.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
